summary: Implemented `py:type` and `:py:type:` with PyObject registration, canonical annotation rendering, Python cross-reference resolution, and module-aware index text. Documented the directive and role and added regression coverage for module and class aliases, canonical and omitted expressions, role resolution, and index text. Verified with the provided Python environment: 67 focused tests passed; `git diff --check` passed. Broader test suites were not run.
